newsitem.title: UK: Duff & Phelps rates India foreign currency.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates India foreign currency.

text.p: Duff & Phelps said on Monday it had assigned an initial BBB minus rating to the foreign currency obligations of the Republic of India.
"DCR's investment grade rating reflects the Indian government's strong policy commitment toward establishing a competitive and creditworthy economy," Duff & Phelps said in a statement.
"This commitment is reflected in the stabilisation and structural reforms implemented since the 1990-91 balance of payments crisis," said the statement.

Duff & Phelps said the rating was further supported by strong economic growth since 1993, falling inflation, an improvement in the balance of payments accounts, an unblemished debt service record and an improving trend in external debt indicators.
"High fiscal deficits, infrastructural bottlenecks, slow progress on disinvestment of state-owned enterprises and high income inequality constrain the rating," said Duff & Phelps.
"Frequent changes in the government have caused uncertainty among international investors. Despite these changes, the economic policy stance has shown little change."
